logo.clear_space: At least 16px around the email header lockup
logo.restrictions: Never recolor, stretch, regenerate lettering, or overlay with competing text

navy.usage: Primary brand, text and primary CTA

gold.usage: Primary marketing accent or promotional CTA

gold_dark.usage: Gold shadows and borders; avoid for small body text

green.usage: Illustrated trees only, occasional success accent

typography.display_graphics: Press Start 2P, only in static graphics and short headings
typography.website_heading: Inter or system sans; do not depend on downloading font in email

imagery.rendering: Keep transparency and aspect ratio; nearest-neighbor for enlarging true pixel art
imagery.alt_text: Concise and functional, never duplicate the entire paragraph
imagery.labels: Use real editable HTML text; image generator labels have errors

editorial.cta: One primary action per email; 1-2 placements
editorial.headlines: Keep short, benefit-focused, no invented numbers
editorial.trust: Use clear process and verifiable claims; no manufactured social proof

email.image_coverage: Approx 20-35% of visible newsletter layout; use live text for main copy
email.hero_message: Text + one CTA above fold, not all-image layout

compliance.subscription: Use opt-in/permission-based lists; MLS source contact data is not automatic email marketing consent
compliance.footer: Real physical mailing address and unsubscribe links; CC appends required footer
compliance.trademarks: No SEPTA, Phillies, Flyers, Eagles, Rocky, LOVE sign usage without licensing/review
